narrative: The York leaf as you left it, the messenger still only a mark. The three deposition sheets at the edge, nothing added. The chronicle shut. No face. The blank below the messenger mark is still blank. No prison. No garden. No last scene. No face. Field's Holinshed, still shut, still at the side. The pen is capped. No face.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the old mark and left it.
